facts.text: University of Northwestern – St. Paul operates Northwestern Media, a university broadcast ministry that owns and operates 105 radio signals throughout the Midwest across 13 states with over 2 million listeners.

sources.title: Northwestern Welcomes 11 New Full-Time Faculty for Fall 2026
sources.quote: Northwestern Media, a ministry of the university, owns and operates 105 radio signals throughout the Midwest across 13 states with a total listenership of more than 2 million listeners.
